integrity: Analytical proof supplied with exact normalized moments and tridiagonal monic orthogonalization; reproducibility script carries finite numerical evidence only.
scientific_limitations: A one-angular-Fourier-mode weight, not all Hölder weights. The outer asymptotic does not imply a universal upper rate for arbitrary weights; possible historical implicit specialization needs independent examination.
title: A sharp fractional exterior correction for nonradial Hölder Bergman polynomials
